page.layout: One page of text, centred: title block at top, a woodcut ornament in the middle, imprint and date below. No margins with text.

main_text.l: Gedruckt zu Augspurg / durch Andream Aperger.

page.notes: Woodcut ornament (a mask-like face flanked by scrolls and hanging tassels) between the title and the imprint; no text in it. Title-page setting in mixed roman, italic and black letter; the black-letter words are rendered here in plain letters ("Teutsch", "Italiänische", "Sprach-Kunst", "Das ist", "zulernen", "Gedruckt", "Augspurg", "Andream Aperger", "Verlegung", "Johannes Weh", "Buchhändlers", "daselbsten") and the rendering of the black-letter forms is approximate.
